title: KaChat bots you set up by chatting
summary: The Bot tab becomes a set of bots (Mining notifier, Price bot, Wallet watcher). Set one up, fund its own small wallet with about 10 KAS, then message it in KaChat with its pairing code: it asks what to watch right in the chat. Needs the KaChat Bot reinstalled from its bots branch (Updates, Rebuild).
